root_idea.summary: The root centers on the persistence, fixity, and adhesion of something so that it remains attached or does not readily separate.
root_idea.development: The evidence extends this orientation from fixed or cohesive physical matter to firmness and necessity in figurative usage, while drought is portrayed as a condition that has become fixed in a year.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized active-participle citation form لَازِبٌ rather than the inflected Quranic surface form.

senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic expression مِنْ طِينٍ لَازِبٍ, describes clay characterized by strong adhesion and fixity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or remain fixed, settled, firm, or constant; of mud and the like, to adhere or stick.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The verb has both a general fixedness use and a physical adhesion use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become commixed or intermixed, or contracted, with one part entering another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Describes something becoming internally mingled or compacted.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of mud, to cohere and become hard.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The evidence applies this use specifically to mud.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To denote a time of drought or absence of rain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A verbal description of drought conditions.
An equivalent lexical use in the construction لَزَبَتْهُ العَقْرَبُ.
Used in the cited construction with dates as the subject.
Can describe a strait or a difficult life.
The evidence specifically attests the meaning for a road or path.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An emphatic, imitative sequel after عَزَبٌ, denoting a man without a wife.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a pleonastic corroborative expression following عَزَبٌ.
The evidence illustrates the adjective with scant water but does not limit it to water.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Adversity, difficulty, distress, or drought; a severe year.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May denote either general distress or a severe drought year.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Fixed, settled, firm, or constant; in ضَرْبَةُ لَازِبٍ, a constant, severe, or necessary infliction.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The idiomatic construction describes something that remains fixed or is inescapable and necessary.
A descriptive adjective for pronounced grasping or withholding behavior.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Fixedness and constancy of the Form I verb.
Dates sticking together in Form VI.
Emphatic expression for a man without a wife.
Adhering or cohesive clay, attested in the Quranic form.
The idiom ضَرْبَةُ لَازِبٍ and its constant or necessary infliction sense.
